summary: Pension eligibility after removal from service; appellate authority permitted terminal benefits; reliance on Bank of Baroda v. S.K. Kool; distinction on facts; Ninth Bipartite Settlement exclusion of removed employees; Regulation 22, UCO Bank Pension Regulations, 1995; High Court affirmed grant of pension; issue: whether delinquent employee entitled to pensionary benefits; proportionality of penalty not re-examined.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 226 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; pensionary benefits not granted; respondent not entitled to pension despite terminal benefits entitlement under appellate order.
